how: The session record and its exploit_uuid were read verbatim from msfrpcd session.list right after the run (the run's own result carried no evidence: that is the bug).
The job_uuid is the 24-character RPC job uuid the same run recorded for the previous msf_exploit call (iteration 11, ms17_010_eternalblue).
The psexec job uuid was never captured, because the rejected result (session_provenance_unverified) exposed neither uuid.

The two ids are the same kind of pair the handler used to compare: an 8-character module uuid against a 24-character job uuid. They can never be equal, so the old check rejected every real session (V1-23).
